blocks.text: Langley Farms: what the ground is and what governs it

items.t: A home not connected to a community sewer must use an onsite sewage disposal system that complies with the Sewerage System Regulation, and only an Authorized Person can design, install, repair, maintain or inspect a sewerage system (Fraser Health).

blocks.text: Local rules that affect acreage buyers

items.t: Township zoning: Township of Langley Zoning Bylaw No. 2500 applies across the Township, and Township SSMUH implementation was by Bylaw No. 6020 (November 18, 2024).

Farm class is an income test, not a zoning label: a parcel can be ALR, zoned rural and still lose farm classification if the operation's gross income misses its size tier — and the filing deadline is October 31 every cycle.

faq.q: Can a Langley farm have a second dwelling?
faq.a: On ALR land, one additional detached residence may be permitted without an ALC application where the conditions are met — 90 m² or less on parcels of 40 ha or smaller, 186 m² or less on parcels larger than 40 ha — and Township bylaws must also permit it.

faq.q: What does water diligence look like on a Langley farm purchase?
faq.a: Search GWELLS for the well record, and if the operation irrigates, confirm the water licence position — non-domestic groundwater use requires a licence under the Water Sustainability Act. Septic systems must comply with the Sewerage System Regulation, with work by an Authorized Person only.

faq.q: How big can a house be on ALR land in Langley?
faq.a: A principal residence permitted without an ALC application must have a total floor area of 500 m² or less, with no more than 1,000 m² of fill placed for its construction; a secondary suite is permitted only inside the principal residence.

faq.q: What should I check before buying a farm in Langley Agricultural Mls?
faq.a: Check the ALR status, water source and licences, drainage and flood history, the buildings and any quota or production licences that do or do not transfer with the land. Poultry and egg production in BC are supply-managed, so a sale of the farm does not automatically include quota.

faq.q: What is the ALR and does it apply to farms in Langley Agricultural Mls?
faq.a: The Agricultural Land Reserve is farmland protected by the provincial Agricultural Land Commission. Farm use is generally allowed on ALR land, but subdividing, adding homes or using the land for non-farm purposes usually needs approval, so check a property's ALR status before you offer.
